title: Head and Hand
label: ch:ka-head-and-hand
canDo: I can name the head and the hand in Kannada.

payoff.summary: Say ತಲೆ and ಕೈ, and hear how nearly unchanged they are across Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: KA-C13-dehada-bhagagalu (410) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses its own atom. The other two, KA-SCRIPT-RECOG-122 (ಚ, KA-S122-letter-ca, 415) and KA-SCRIPT-RECOG-144 (೫, KA-S144-digit-five, 417), are taught by script-delivery lessons sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and neither script lesson is a fitting payoff for head and hand.
